dataset: Hong Kong Finance Entry-Level JD Market Baseline — All 304 originally full-source JDs
correction: The user confirmed the 171 records were originally collected as complete JDs, but their current workbook export retains summaries. Treat all 304 as collected source JD records while preserving 133 verbatim/171 condensed distinction.

formula.employer_balanced_mention: M(r,s) = mean_{employers in role r}(#role postings with observed skill s / #role postings of employer)
formula.employer_balanced_required_full: R(r,s) = mean_{employers with full text}(#full-text role postings explicitly Required s / #full-text role postings of employer)
formula.employer_balanced_preferred_full: P(r,s) = mean_{employers with full text}(#full-text role postings explicitly Preferred s / #full-text role postings of employer)
formula.job_specific_item_weight: u_i = 1 + W(role, JD_skill_i), only when the actual job requirement type is classified
formula.required_coverage: C_req = sum(u_i*e_i for actual JD Required items)/sum(u_i for Required items)
formula.preferred_coverage: C_pref = sum(u_i*e_i for actual JD Preferred items)/sum(u_i for Preferred items)
formula.gate_separate: Hard requirements checked independently and cannot be offset by score
formula.type_missingness: Unclear excerpt-source requirements contribute to observed skill mention only; they do NOT prove Preferred, Required or lack thereof

parameters.nature: All are transparent, provisional heuristics awaiting human-labelled validation

methodology_notes: All 304 original JD-source records included in observed-skill rates. A skill omitted from the condensed export is UNKNOWN, not absent.
Required/Preferred rates use only classifications supported by retained full-text records (133).
Company-balanced rates reduce distortion from single company posting many similar graduate vacancies.
Scope-review flags and possible duplicate remain until manual resolution.
Normalized skills extracted from JD text and summaries, deduplicated once per JD per skill; include Professional Skills, Soft Skills, Tools/Software, Certifications only.
The adjusted contextual weight boosts relevance, it is NOT an entry eligibility gate.
External research is used for conceptual triangulation, not pooled quantitatively with JD ratios.
